title: Where every film was shot: film cities, foreign productions and James Bond on one map
excerpt: I mapped the filming locations of 23,468 films in Wikidata: Los Angeles, New York, London and Paris lead, Canada hosts the most foreign productions, and the 25 Eon Bond films visited 36 countries and territories.
seo_description: A map of where films were shot, from Wikidata: the busiest film cities, which countries host foreign productions, and every James Bond location.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where every film was shot' in black, red and teal on cream, beside a world map of small hexagons shaded yellow to dark purple, densest in the United States and western Europe. Text: 23,468 films and 7,926 filming locations in Wikidata, from Los Angeles to Pinewood, plus every Bond location.
